name: @thorrangonak/kanka
description: kanka — Türkçe konuşan terminal kodlama asistanı. 'Kanka, şunu yapsana.'

scripts.build: npm run version-sync && tsc && shx chmod +x dist/cli.js && npm run copy-bundled
scripts.copy-bundled: shx mkdir -p dist/bundled-agents dist/bundled-prompts dist/bundled-personas dist/bundled-skills && shx cp bundled-agents/*.md dist/bundled-agents/ && shx cp bundled-prompts/*.md dist/bundled-prompts/ && shx cp bundled-personas/*.md dist/bundled-personas/ && shx cp -r bundled-skills/* dist/bundled-skills/
scripts.version: npm run version-sync && git add src/version.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: thorrangonak
